sources.prompt: A cute couple photo pose facing camera. Your partner is on your left. Lift your left arm in a large curved arc above your head to form half of a big heart with your partner. Bend the elbow overhead and point fingertips inward. Right hand on hip. Gently tilt head toward partner, keep face visible looking forward. Hold seconds 2 to 6, subtle breathing, feet planted, no turns.

Stand facing the camera for a cute portrait. Lift the right hand out to the side beside the shoulder and make a V peace sign, palm forward. Keep the hand outside the face silhouette. Left hand rests on hip. Feet planted with a small relaxed knee bend. Head upright looking straight ahead throughout. Hold the pose from second 2 through 6. No turning or walking.
